AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Verified administrator account profile authorized to manage MS TV cloud backups.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified Google email address of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin profile was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin profile was last updated.

VaultManifest.title: VaultManifest
VaultManifest.description: Metadata manifest for an AES-256-GCM encrypted MS TV server backup.

ownerUid.description: UID of the administrator who owns this backup manifest.

chunkCount.description: Number of encrypted chunk documents stored in the chunks subcollection.

totalChannels.description: Total number of channels stored inside the encrypted backup.

totalSources.description: Total number of IPTV sources stored inside the encrypted backup.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the backup manifest.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent sync.

VaultChunk.title: VaultChunk
VaultChunk.description: Single AES-256-GCM encrypted binary-safe payload slice belonging to a VaultManifest.

ownerUid.description: UID of the administrator who owns the parent manifest.

cipherPayload.description: Base64url-encoded AES-256-GCM encrypted server store slice.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when chunk was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when chunk was updated.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Stores verified administrator profiles used for RBAC verification.

/vault_manifests/{manifestId}.description: Stores top-level encrypted backup metadata owned by a verified administrator.

/vault_manifests/{manifestId}/chunks/{ch.description: Subcollection storing bounded AES-256-GCM ciphertext slices for large channel catalogs.
